title: PRESSER | Terez Davis - Mississippi State Preview (11-24-26)
text: questions for >> just going into this week, you were obviously a part of this team last year that went to the Egg Bowl and just now that you've been here before, what's it like going into your second one? >> Yeah. Uh, you know, it's definitely a big time game. You know, what it what it means to the state of Mississippi. You know, I'm not from Mississippi, but you know, Tom Luke gave us a great, you know, why it's important game. So, it it's good. You know, we want to dominate them every time we play them. So, it's big. >> What's this Hall Luke speech like? I' I've been dying to ask someone. I've heard so many good things, but what's it like? >> Yeah, it's uh it's intense, you know, just from his time playing here and, you know, I think he's played him three times. He lost to him once and he hates it, you know, and he kind of just expresses his feelings towards it and just trying to motivate motivate us to beat him. >> Coming into the season, the offensive line wasn't necessarily the highlight of this team, but it has kind of turned into one of this team. What is it about this offensive line that's allowed you guys to have such a great season? >> Yeah, I would say, you know, Coach Garrison and, you know, all the coaches we got, Coach Meaf, Coach James, and just the familiarity with each other, you know, me, Connor, Cudis, Leno, Bryson, like we all were here last year. So, we got that, you know, camaraderie together and it just makes us pretty good. So, >> and for you specifically, what has worked so well? You kind of worked your way up into this starting role and you've become kind of a star on this offensive line. Yeah, I would say, you know, just my my teammates around me, they really pushed me every day to work. Um, in the spring, you know, I kind of just gave it my all and put all the distractions aside and just, you know, focus focused on my work every day. So, >> what goes into the calculation for you potentially stay in or I imagine with this year, you're getting some NFL draft kind of opportunities. Where where's your head at in all that? >> Yeah. Uh, you know, it's a little bit of both. You know, NFL, there's some grades and stuff and as far as staying, so it's kind of just, you know, weigh [snorts] them options. So, I talked to Pete and stuff. So, we're trying to, you know, work everything out and see what's best. >> Is that tough to balance in the middle of the season or do you lean on your experiences last year with so much chaos? >> Yeah, it's not hard at all. You know, at the end of the day, I like I told Pete and everyone my focus is, you know, just playing the games, you know, that that that's what it means. That's what I came here for and that's why I'm here just to finish strong and play the games and then let everything else happen later. kind of with that and weighing your options and everything, does a bowl game appearance for you stand out at all to help maybe help raise your draft stock or are you kind of not unsure about the ball game so far? >> Oh, yeah. No, I'm playing 100% thousand%. Wouldn't miss it. >> Yep. >> What is it about the culture here? Like Trinidad said the same thing. 100% I'm playing. You're you're you're all in. What What is it about the culture here that you know, not every team, not every guy who talks this week is saying that? >> Yeah. Um, I would say just your brothers, you know, when you sitting here and you you go eat with them and you went through fall camp with them, you know, it's it's important to have their back. And I told them from the start of season, I'm going to have y'all back regardless of what happens. So, just playing from, you know, that's what I do it for. I play for the guys next to me, Cudis, all the senior especially all the seniors. So, I I would hope they do the same for me. I'm going to do the same for them. kind of with the culture thing and just how important this week is just to these teams. Even with it kind of the playoffs being out of reach and a guaranteed bowl game though, how important is it this week to still go out there and play and um just the buy in of this team? >> Yeah. No, it's very important, you know, especially a rivalry game, you know, um like I said, we don't we don't like those guys, you know, they don't like us. So, just the competitiveness if you're a competitor, I mean, this is the game you want to play in. So, I feel like that just raises the bar of how important it is. just on film and through other studies and maybe you've seen them play earlier this season. What have what have you seen from their defense? What are you kind of looking out for there? >> Yeah. Um they're they're big physical, you know, they do a lot of moving and stuff like that. Try to get you to, you know, over overcommit on stuff and then they'll loop out. They do a lot of stuff. They're very big physical up front. So, it's going to be a tough tough game, but good challenge for us. >> Questions? >> Okay. Thanks for asking.
